name: Winter's Presents
summary: In Orgrimmar, Winter's Presents await beneath the festive tree during the Feast of Winter Veil. Holiday organizers and goblin apparatus tenders direct Horde heroes to Great-father Winter, where gifts have been prepared for them.

sections.title: Season of Generosity
sections.body: The Feast of Winter Veil brings a pause for celebration to Orgrimmar as the chill winds of late year sweep across Durotar. Promoters from Smokywood Pastures and holiday enthusiasts spread word through the capital that gifts wait beneath the decorated tree. Warriors, hunters, and wanderers resting in the city are all invited to share in the season’s generosity.

sections.title: The Patron and the Peddlers
sections.body: Great-father Winter sits among holiday ribbons and packaged cartons near the Smokywood Pastures market. The ancient figure marks the season’s renewal, while goblin merchants nearby offer seasonal wares and festive treats to visitors.

faq.q: Where do I turn in Winter's Presents?
faq.answer: You find Great-father Winter near the Smokywood Pastures festive area and decorated tree in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Who sends you to see Great-father Winter?
faq.answer: A Holiday Enthusiast or a goblin Wonderform Operator tending the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt machines around the holiday setups can direct you to the tree.
Smokywood Pastures is a goblin merchant organization that sponsors and supplies the Winter Veil festivities, food, treats, and gifts across major capitals.

faq.q: What does Great-father Winter do once you speak with him?
faq.answer: Great-father Winter welcomes you to the Feast of Winter Veil and points you to the wrapped parcels beneath the tree. He also suggests Smokywood Pastures merchandise for your companions.

faq.q: Why does the Horde celebrate Winter Veil in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Horde celebrates Winter Veil as a time for respite, feasting, and community while struggling to build a new home in Kalimdor. The modern festival has roots in ancient legends of winter’s renewal.

faq.q: What is the PX-238 Winter Wondervolt mentioned by the operator?
faq.answer: The PX-238 Winter Wondervolt is a goblin contraption near the festival grounds that temporarily transforms volunteers into festively dressed Little Helpers.

angles.text: For the Horde, Orgrimmar’s holiday camp offers a joyful, warm gathering spot amid the ongoing border conflicts across Kalimdor.
As an orc, you can pause your duties even in the Warchief’s austere seat to share winter feasts and accept hospitality beneath the Winter Veil tree’s boughs.
